text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if this new lotion
didn't agree with my skin...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...—
It seems it might be better to revert it to how it was before...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu found herself fretting
over her skin breakout...
